body.en: This chapter builds the two sequence families EST II Math Level 2 tests — arithmetic (constant difference) and geometric (constant ratio) — and the surprising idea that an infinite sum can still equal a finite number, as long as the terms shrink fast enough.
body.ar: This chapter builds the two المتتالية families EST II Math Level 2 tests — arithmetic (الثابت difference) and geometric (الثابت ratio) — and the surprising idea that an infinite sum can still equal a finite number, as long as the terms shrink fast enough.

body.en:
A sequence \( a_1,a_2,a_3,\dots \) is arithmetic if consecutive terms differ by a constant \( d \): \( a_{n+1}=a_n+d \). Its explicit formula is

\[ a_n=a_1+(n-1)d. \]
body.ar:
A المتتالية \( a_1,a_2,a_3,\dots \) is arithmetic if consecutive terms differ by a الثابت \( d \): \( a_{n+1}=a_n+d \). Its explicit الصيغة is

\[ a_n=a_1+(n-1)d. \]

body.en:
The sum of an arithmetic sequence's first \( n \) terms is

\[ S_n=\frac{n}{2}\big(a_1+a_n\big)=\frac{n}{2}\big(2a_1+(n-1)d\big). \]
body.ar:
The sum of an arithmetic المتتالية's first \( n \) terms is

\[ S_n=\frac{n}{2}\big(a_1+a_n\big)=\frac{n}{2}\big(2a_1+(n-1)d\big). \]

body.en:
Find the sum of the first \( 12 \) terms of the sequence from Example 2.A (\( a_1=7,\,d=5 \)).

\[ S_{12}=\frac{12}{2}\big(2(7)+11(5)\big)=6(14+55)=6(69)=414. \]

body.en:
A sequence is geometric if consecutive terms share a constant ratio \( r\neq0 \): \( a_{n+1}=r\,a_n \), with explicit formula

\[ a_n=a_1\,r^{\,n-1}. \]
body.ar:
A المتتالية is geometric if consecutive terms share a الثابت ratio \( r\neq0 \): \( a_{n+1}=r\,a_n \), with explicit formula

\[ a_n=a_1\,r^{\,n-1}. \]

label.en: Worked example 2.C — Find a geometric term
label.ar: مثال محلول 2.C — Find a geometric term

body.en:
A geometric sequence has \( a_1=4 \) and \( r=3 \). Find \( a_6 \).

\[ a_6=4\cdot3^{5}=4\cdot243=972. \]
body.ar:
A geometric المتتالية has \( a_1=4 \) and \( r=3 \). Find \( a_6 \).

\[ a_6=4\cdot3^{5}=4\cdot243=972. \]

body.en:
For \( r\neq1 \), the sum of the first \( n \) terms of a geometric sequence is

\[ S_n=\frac{a_1(r^n-1)}{r-1}. \]
body.ar:
For \( r\neq1 \), the sum of the first \( n \) terms of a geometric المتتالية is

\[ S_n=\frac{a_1(r^n-1)}{r-1}. \]

body.en: Write \( S_n=a_1+a_1r+a_1r^2+\cdot s+a_1r^{n-1} \). Multiply by \( r \): \( rS_n=a_1r+a_1r^2+\cdot s+a_1r^{n} \). Subtracting the first sum from the second cancels every middle term, leaving \( rS_n-S_n=a_1r^{n}-a_1 \), so \( S_n(r-1)=a_1(r^n-1) \). Since \( r\neq1 \), divide by \( r-1 \): \( S_n=\dfrac{a_1(r^n-1)}{r-1} \). \( \blacksquare \)
body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (المتتابعات والمتسلسلات اللانهائية):

Write \( S_n=a_1+a_1r+a_1r^2+\cdot s+a_1r^{n-1} \). Multiply by \( r \): \( rS_n=a_1r+a_1r^2+\cdot s+a_1r^{n} \). Subtracting the first sum from the second cancels every middle term, leaving \( rS_n-S_n=a_1r^{n}-a_1 \), so \( S_n(r-1)=a_1(r^n-1) \). Since \( r\neq1 \), divide by \( r-1 \): \( S_n=\dfrac{a_1(r^n-1)}{r-1} \). \( \blacksquare \)

label.ar: مثال محلول 2.D — Sum a geometric المتسلسلة

body.en:
If \( |r|<1 \), the infinite geometric series converges to

\[ S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}. \] If \( |r|\geq1 \) (and \( a_1\neq0 \)), the series diverges.
body.ar:
If \( |r|<1 \), the infinite geometric المتسلسلة converges to

\[ S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}. \] If \( |r|\geq1 \) (and \( a_1\neq0 \)), the المتسلسلة diverges.

body.en: By Theorem 2.1, \( S_n=\dfrac{a_1}{1-r}(1-r^n) \). When \( |r|<1 \), repeated multiplication by a factor smaller than \( 1 \) in absolute value forces \( r^n\to0 \) as \( n\to\infty \), so \( S_n\to\dfrac{a_1}{1-r} \). When \( |r|\geq1 \), \( r^n \) never shrinks toward \( 0 \), so \( S_n \) never settles on a finite value. \( \blacksquare \)
body.ar: By مبرهنة 2.1, \( S_n=\dfrac{a_1}{1-r}(1-r^n) \). عندما \( |r|<1 \), repeated multiplication by a factor smaller than \( 1 \) in absolute value forces \( r^n\to0 \) as \( n\to\infty \), so \( S_n\to\dfrac{a_1}{1-r} \). عندما \( |r|\geq1 \), \( r^n \) never shrinks toward \( 0 \), so \( S_n \) never settles on a finite value. \( \blacksquare \)

label.ar: مثال محلول 2.E — Sum an infinite geometric المتسلسلة

body.en:
Find \( 54+18+6+2+\cdot s \).

Here \( a_1=54 \) and \( r=\tfrac13 \) (each term is a third of the last), and \( |r|=\tfrac13<1 \), so \[ S_\infty=\frac{54}{1-\tfrac13}=\frac{54}{\tfrac23}=81. \]
body.ar:
الشرح الرياضي (المتتابعات والمتسلسلات اللانهائية):

Find \( 54+18+6+2+\cdot s \).

Here \( a_1=54 \) and \( r=\tfrac13 \) (each term is a third of the last), and \( |r|=\tfrac13<1 \), so \[ S_\infty=\frac{54}{1-\tfrac13}=\frac{54}{\tfrac23}=81. \]

body.en:
Common Ratio Sign: In alternating geometric series like \(12 - 6 + 3 - \cdot s\), the common ratio is negative: \(r = -1/2\). Writing \(r = 1/2\) alters the denominator \(1 - r\) from \(1 - (-1/2) = 3/2\) to \(1/2\), resulting in an answer off by a factor of 3.

Number of Terms in Arithmetic Series: Never assume the number of terms \(n\) is the last number written. Always compute \(n = \dfrac{a_n - a_1}{d} + 1\).

Divergent Geometric Series: If \(|r| \geq 1\), the infinite sum \(S_\infty\) does not exist. Do not blindly use \(\dfrac{a_1}{1-r}\) on divergent series.
body.ar:

Number of Terms in Arithmetic المتسلسلة: Never assume the number of terms \(n\) is the last number written. Always compute \(n = \dfrac{a_n - a_1}{d} + 1\).

Divergent Geometric المتسلسلة: If \(|r| \geq 1\), the infinite sum \(S_\infty\) does not exist. Do not blindly use \(\dfrac{a_1}{1-r}\) on divergent المتسلسلة.

body.en: Binomial Validity Shortcut (Egyptian Scholastic Test (EST II — Math Level 2)): When asked for the range of \(x\) for which the expansion of \((a + bx)^n\) is valid, write \(\left|\dfrac{bx}{a}\right| < 1 \implies |x| < \left|\dfrac{a}{b}\right|\). If multiplying two expansions, take the intersection (smaller radius) of the two validity intervals.

question.en: [Practice 2 · Easy] Consider an arithmetic sequence where the first term is \( a_1 = 5 \) and the common difference is \( d = 3 \). What is the value of the 4th term, \( a_4 \)?
question.ar: [Practice 2 · Easy] Consider an arithmetic sequence حيث the first term is \( a_1 = 5 \) and the common dإذا كانference is \( d = 3 \). ما قيمة the 4th term, \( a_4 \)?

hints.en: The formula for the nth term of an arithmetic sequence is given by \( a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d \).
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \( a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d \) لتبسيط الخطوة.

hints.en: In this problem, we are given \( a_1 = 5 \) and \( d = 3 \). We need to find the 4th term, so \( n = 4 \). Plugging these values into the formula, we get: \( a_4 = 5 + (4-1) \times 3 \) \( a_4 = 5 + (3) \times 3 \) \( a_4 = 5 + 9 \) \( a_4 = 14 \).
hints.ar: In this problem, we are given \( a_1 = 5 \) and \( d = 3 \). We need to أوجد 4th term, so \( n = 4 \). Plugging these values into the formula, we get: \( a_4 = 5 + (4-1) \times 3 \) \( a_4 = 5 + (3) \times 3 \) \( a_4 = 5 + 9 \) \( a_4 = 14 \).

hints.en: Therefore, the 4th term of the sequence is 14.
